entities.summary: The Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa, generally referred to by its French acronym CEMAC, is an organization of states of Central Africa established by Cameroon, Central African Republic, Chad, the Republic of the Congo, Equatorial Guinea and Gabon to promote economic integration among countries that share a common currency, the Central African CFA franc.
